title: P&G to Webcast Fireside Chat From the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference, September 10
summary: P&G to Webcast Fireside Chat From the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference, September 10
body_markdown:
CINCINNATI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Andre Schulten, Chief Financial Officer of The Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE:PG) will be a featured speaker at the Barclays Global Consumer Staples Conference on Thursday, September 10, 2026, at 8:15 A.M. ET (Eastern Time).


Media and investors may access the live audio webcast at[www.pginvestor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.pginvestor.com&esheet=54598010&newsitemid=20260903143343&lan=en-US&anchor=www.pginvestor.com&index=1&md5=8636cdbf3879af8070fee93d2845857e) . The webcast will also be available for replay.


**About Procter & Gamble**


P&G serves consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ambi Pur®, Ariel®, Bounty®, Charmin®, Crest®, Dawn®, Downy®, Fairy®, Febreze®, Gain®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Lenor®, Olay®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, SK-II®, Tide®, Vicks®, and Whisper®. The P&G community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.
